render_puzzle_previews: render puzzle preview images from PushWorld puzzle files into a specified output directory
render_plans: render MP4 videos of planning results from YAML files using PushWorld puzzle definitions
create_render_puzzle_previews: create puzzle preview images by calling render_puzzle_previews with image and puzzle paths
run_render_plans: run plan video generation from planning result YAML files to MP4 output directory
test_render_puzzle_previews: test render_puzzle_previews function with a puzzle directory and output image path
